Caviar Stick Eye Shadow Shimmer application is effortless. Simply swipe, blend, and go!

Swipe: Apply directly to eye lid.

Blend: Blend with fingers or brush. Be sure to blend quickly before product sets. 

Go!

Pro Tips: 

For light or medium shades, use All Over Eye Color Brush for a quick wash of color. To ensure seamless application closer to the lash line use a smaller flat brush like Eye Color Brush. 

The darker the shade, the smaller the brush. Blend light shades with Finishing Pony Tail Brush and darker shades with the Eye Crease Brush. 

Use small brushes like Smudge Brush and Smoky Eye Liner Brush for finer application around the lash line.
